```{python}
import _lib as L
import itables
itables.init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False, connected=True)

gold = L.xlsx("zloty_zbior_do_oznaczenia.xlsx")
lem = L.xlsx("ocena_lematyzacji_300.xlsx")
n = lambda v: L.fmt(int(v))
filled = lambda s: int(s.notna().sum())
```

Both files are meant to be downloaded, filled in and returned. They are shown here so that their content can be
inspected without opening Excel.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Gold-set worksheet

`{python} n(len(gold))` candidates, drawn in equal numbers from each final label and, within a label, half from
the cases the models agreed on and half from the adjudicated ones, then shuffled. Each row shows the candidate, its
counts and up to three sentences from the corpus. The sheet deliberately carries **no model labels**, so that two
annotators can label independently; the key with the labels and the sampling weights stays outside the published
files. The second tab of the file holds the instructions (in Polish) with the definitions of T3, T3_INNY, T2, T1 and
SZUM. Filled in so far: annotator A `{python} n(filled(gold["kategoria_oceniajacy_A"]))`, annotator B
`{python} n(filled(gold["kategoria_oceniajacy_B"]))` of `{python} n(len(gold))`. Once the file is saved as
`zloty_zbior_oznaczony.xlsx` next to the original, step 6 reports agreement between the annotators and weighted
precision, recall and F1 of the final labels.

```{python}
L.source("zloty_zbior_do_oznaczenia.xlsx")
L.glossary(gold.columns)
L.dt(gold, page=25, wrap=["zdanie_1", "zdanie_2", "zdanie_3"])
```

## Lemmatisation sheet (300 forms)

`{python} n(len(lem))` inflected forms with their sentence, the reference base form, and the answer of every tool.
Columns `lemat_poprawny_czlowiek` and `pos_poprawny_czlowiek` are for the human checker
(`{python} n(filled(lem["lemat_poprawny_czlowiek"]))` filled in so far). Once the sheet is saved as
`ocena_lematyzacji_300_sprawdzone.xlsx` next to the original, step 2 recomputes the benchmark against those answers.

```{python}
L.source("ocena_lematyzacji_300.xlsx")
L.glossary(lem.columns)
L.dt(lem, page=25, wrap=["kontekst"], hide=[c for c in lem.columns if c.endswith("_pos")])
```

:::
